model: Eye A LR wmean frozen; existing saved threshold
sequence: B separate zein head readiness gate
structures: PubChem-confirmed named discrete identities only; no coco chain, EO average, glucoside oligomer or alkyl range assumptions. Named identity does not establish experimental commercial lot purity.
primary: All named components resolved; group duplicate observations by component pair, proportion and concentration, average ZN then derive ZN>=200 label
secondary: Only resolved constituents of incomplete mixtures; never pool with all-components-resolved results
weights: Use source proportion as nominal relative input only, not verified absolute active mass. Explicitly flag basis unverified. Single component normalized to one. No conversion to absolute amount_pct.
endpoint: ZN>=200 operational source cutoff, not EPA Eye gold; official cutoff attribution not independently verified
metrics: Descriptive agreement, confusion matrix, ROC AUC and Spearman, separately by coverage; no independent-sample p-value or EPA performance claim
overlap: Flag SLS; compare exact feature vectors against preserved training reference; exclude matches in sensitivity
B_gate: Preserve Eye model. Require actual compatible frozen encoder for separate head, resolved structures and amounts, component-disjoint and scaffold-disjoint valid heldout sets. Do not substitute an unrelated model or silently relax split rules.
prior_exposure: Dataset outcomes already inspected in prior work; this is not a prospectively untouched external test set.
source_retrieval: Zenodo API and landing page both HTTP 403; original workbook is available locally. Absolute mixture concentration basis remains unverified.
